name: minisoc
description: MiniSOC — Lightweight Security Operations Center Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
